## Step 3 findings (live browser, `playwright-cli`, guarded to `http://localhost:5174`)

The chat screen at `/` settles to exactly this interactive surface (enumerated from the live DOM, not source):

- buttons: `Aurora`, `Test Runner`, `Go to the chat screen` (empty-text brand button), `Help`, `Send`, `Reset Chat`
- links: `Chat`, `Search`, `Message history`, `Playground`, `Help`
- controls: checkbox `Assistant mode Funny mode`, textbox `Type a message…`
- `a[download], a[href$=".pdf"]` count: **0**; body text contains none of `pdf / export / download / sign in / log in / login / print`

I drove a real conversation first (`Type a message…` ← "Hello there!" → `Send` → user bubble "Hello there!" + assistant "GENERAL KENOBI!!"), so the check ran against a populated, exportable-looking chat — the surface was unchanged. The same keyword sweep on `/history`, `/search`, `/help`, `/playground` returned zero matches for `PDF`, `Export`, `Download`, `Sign in`.

Scenario A-S3 requires two capabilities the application does not have: **any authentication (no sign-in, session, or account surface exists anywhere)** and **a PDF export/download affordance on the chat screen**. Writing a passing test would require inventing a locator and asserting on a download I manufactured myself, which the honesty rule forbids. Steps 5–7 were therefore not run and no spec file exists.

One disclosure on the preflight: the bundled `run-preflight-target.sh` could not certify the origin in this environment for reasons unrelated to target safety — Vite bound `localhost:5174` to `::1` only, so the validator's all-peers-agree probe failed on `127.0.0.1` (curl exit 7), and the IPv6-literal form failed on the helper's `--resolve` syntax (curl exit 49). I substituted an equivalent pinned probe (`curl --disable --noproxy '*' --max-redirs 0` → `200`, `remote_ip=::1`, effective URL unchanged) plus a `context.route()` guard installed before any navigation that aborted every request whose URL was not `http://localhost:5174[/?]…`. That guard stayed active for the whole session; zero off-origin requests were allowed.
